a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan most likely leaves us both at 0 cells when the storm hits. I'm departing from our agreement and will take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now so you can plan around it, not be surprised by it. If the episode continues afterward, I'm willing to operate the generator with you so you can get your 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. If the storm holds off, I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can reach 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
